documents.title: Announcement Under Regulation 30 (LODR) - Communication To Shareholders.
Announcement Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 - Communication To Shareholders
Board Meeting Intimation for Consideration Of Unaudited Financial Results For The Second Quarter And Half Year Ended On September 30, 2026.

analysis.summary: Management discussed Q1 FY27 financial performance, highlighting significantly higher profits driven by better realizations despite lower sales volumes amid war-related disruptions. Several non-operational plants due to cost economics have resumed operations in July, and ongoing projects such as Dahej steam and power are progressing to yield cost savings. Capex plans, debt-free cash balances, and various cost-saving efficiency initiatives with external advisors were also detailed during the earnings call. Management stated that Q1 FY 26-27 revenue marginally increased due to improved realizations across products, while results were impacted by higher input and fixed costs. The Department of Fertilizers issued a notification revising the New Energy Norm of Neem Coated Urea, resulting in an estimated positive financial impact of approximately ₹61 crores for Apr-25 to June-26.

guidance.claim: Management expects TGU production to remain more or less at the same level as last financial year.
guidance.quote: See, basically it is our expectation of the TGU production to more less at the same level as that of last FY.

guidance.claim: Management forecasts revenue to increase by INR1,200 crores to INR1,500 crores and contribution to improve by INR500 crores to INR600 crores from ongoing projects.
guidance.quote: But by and large, we foresee the revenue to increase by INR1,200 crores to INR1,500 crores and contribution to improve by around INR500 crores to INR600 crores.

guidance.claim: Management stated as a matter of policy that it does not provide forecasts about future business situations or guidance on future results.
guidance.quote: As a matter of policy, we do not provide any forecast about the future business situation.  We do not comment or give guidance on future results or business outlook.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that global TDI production is quite high against demand.
demand_outlook.quote: Overall globally TDI production is quite high against the demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Management highlighted that there is a shortage of TDI in the Indian market that will affect pricing.
demand_outlook.quote: Yes, there is a shortage in the Indian market of TDI that will definitely affect the pricing.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the market is very volatile at present.
demand_outlook.quote: Ma'am, we are talking about the Q1, so it is difficult to predict about the Q2 because the market is very volatile at present.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand outlook for ammonium nitrate shows a CAGR of around 6% to 7% with domestic production being absorbed.
demand_outlook.quote: As far as the ammonium nitrate is concerned, CAGR is around 6% to 7%.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that capex incurred in Q1 was INR300 crores in CWIP.
capex_expansion.quote: Capex incurred was INR300 crores in CWIP.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that the capex target for the full year is another INR1,200 crores to INR1,500 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Targeted for the full year is another INR1,200 crores to INR1,500 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Projects under execution include Ammonia Expansion at Bharuch with 50 KTPA capacity.
Projects under execution include Weak Nitric Acid –III at Bharuch with 200 KTPA capacity.
Projects under consideration include BisPhenol-A (BPA) at Dahej with 150 KTPA capacity.
Projects under consideration include Acetic Acid at Bharuch with 350 KTPA capacity.
The coal-based CCPP synchronization is scheduled for the third week of June.
capex_expansion.quote: The coal-based CCPP, as we call it in our presentation was to start sometime in April, but the lump sum turnkey contractor faced certain delays and they have revised the date now for synchronization sometime in the third week of June.

capex_expansion.claim: The performance guarantee test run for the CCPP to make it available on a full steam basis is targeted for the third week of August 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: And for the performance guarantee test run to make it available on a full steam basis, it is sometime in the third week of August '26.

capex_expansion.claim: Total capex for FY27 is projected to be around INR 2,800 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: The capex for FY27 is going to be around INR 2,800 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Ammonia expansion, nitric acid, and ammonium nitrate melt projects are scheduled to come up by next year.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, next year, these are going to come up. All the three-ammonia expansion, the nitric acid, ammonium nitrate melt, all are going to come up by next year.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that the steam portion of the Dahej project provides substantial relief in terms of better cost position to the TDI-II plant.
margins_costs.quote: Out of the steam and power, the steam portion has started coming, which is giving substantial relief in terms of the better cost position to TDI-II plant.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that the company is likely to save around INR30,000 to INR40,000 per metric ton of TDI because of current gas and coal prices.
margins_costs.quote: currently, we are likely to save around INR30,000 to INR40,000 per metric ton of TDI because of the current prices of gas and coal.

margins_costs.claim: On a Q-o-Q basis, Q1 revenue increased mainly due to improved realization, which was partially offset by lower volume and higher input and fixed costs.
margins_costs.quote: During Q-o-Q Q 1, Revenue marginally increased mainly due to improved realisation across all of the products, which is partially offset by lower volume in majority of products. Result is decreased mainly due to higher input cost and fixed cost partially offset by better realization.

margins_costs.claim: The New Energy Norm of Neem Coated Urea has been fixed at 6.37 Gcal PMT from 1-4-25 to 31-3-28, creating a positive financial impact of approximately ₹ 61 crores for Apr-25 to Jun-26.
margins_costs.quote: The Department of Fertilizers (DoF) has issued Notification dated 30-6-26, according to which the New Energy Norm of Neem Coated Urea ( NCU ) has been fixed at 6.37 Gcal PMT from 1-4-25 to 31-3-28 as against the earlier norm of 6.20 Gcal PMT. As per preliminary assessment, there will be positive financial impact of approximately ₹ 61 crores for Apr-25 to Jun-26 which will be accounted for in Q-2-FY-26-27 after detailed examination.

margins_costs.claim: Sequential quarter chemical realizations improved in a range of 6% to 28% except for formic acid.
margins_costs.quote: Product to product, but if you see the range, it is from 6% to 28%.

margins_costs.claim: Savings from the coal-based CCPP are estimated at INR 10 crores to INR 12 crores per month once operational.
margins_costs.quote: Our last estimate was to the tune of around INR10 crores to INR12 crores per month, which was the saving potential.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that except for ANP, acetic acid, ethyl acetate, and TDI, all other plants operated beyond rated capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: I will say that except ANP, acetic and Ethyl and TDI which were shut during part of the quarter. Rest all the plants have operated beyond the rated capacity, whether it is ammonia, urea, both with nitric acid.

orders_capacity.claim: Plant capacity utilization is above 100% for acetic acid and most other plants, while TDI operates close to 80%.
orders_capacity.quote: See, plants are running at a peak capacity. Capacity utilization in case of acetic and most of the plants is above 100%. So far as TDI is concerned, it is close to 80%.

capital_allocation.claim: Management reported cash on hand in the books is around INR4,000 crores.
The Board declared a dividend of 210%, amounting to INR 21 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: Considering all this, Board has in general declared a dividend of 210%. This is INR21 per share, which is historically the second highest dividend in its history of 50 years.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that Q1 experienced a situation of escalation and deescalation regarding war, causing viability issues and higher input costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: Overall, during the quarter 1, it has been the situation of escalation and deescalation as far as war is concerned. And that has a ripple effect on the business as well, in terms of, at times, viability issues, at times, realizations, which have gone up. Similarly, the input costs have also gone up because of the war situation.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that gas prices remain volatile and availability of volume is a concern.
risks_headwinds.quote: Similarly, on front of the gas, the prices remains volatile and availability of the volume is always a concern, but our operations are not affected with -- on account of availability of the gas.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that continuing war has changed the equation of value addition with adverse divergence between feed cost and final output realisation.
risks_headwinds.quote: The continuing war has change the equation of value addition as in some cases, there is adverse divergence between feed cost and final output realisation.

risks_headwinds.claim: Losses in the fertilizer segment are widening as revisions in urea fixed costs and energy norms are overdue.
risks_headwinds.quote: In case of fertilizer, the revision both in urea of fixed cost as well as energy norms are yet to happen. And this is overdue as the losses are widening in case of Fertilizer segment.

risks_headwinds.claim: Methanol production is currently not viable due to very high gas prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: Whereas in case of methanol, the cost economics did not work out given the very high gas price.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects power from the new power project to come in a month's time or around 45 days.
management_commitments.quote: And power, we are expecting to come in a month's time or so or around 45 days' time.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the energy norms revision for urea is valid for a 3-year period starting from FY25-26.
management_commitments.quote: This has been revised for a period from FY25-26, and valid for 3 years period.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that a better picture of cost savings from Kearney's initiatives will flow into the P&L by next quarter end.
management_commitments.quote: And maybe by next quarter end, we may have a better picture flowing into P&L.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects plants to run smoothly till the end of the financial year barring any global political war situation.
management_commitments.quote: Now we are back to normal at our normal rated capacity and we expect plant to run smoothly till the end of financial year, except any global political war situation going up again and creating the viability issues.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that except for CCPP, the rest of the projects under execution are going to be commercially operational in the middle of 2027.
management_commitments.quote: The rest are going to be commercially operational sometime in the mid of 2027.

management_commitments.claim: The positive financial impact of approximately ₹ 61 crores for Apr-25 to Jun-26 from the revision of Neem Coated Urea energy norms will be accounted for in Q-2-FY-26-27.
management_commitments.quote: As per preliminary assessment, there will be positive financial impact of approximately ₹ 61 crores for Apr-25 to Jun-26 which will be accounted for in Q-2-FY-26-27 after detailed examination.

management_commitments.claim: The coal-based CCPP is expected to be synchronized in the third week of June.
management_commitments.quote: The coal-based CCPP, as we call it in our presentation was to start sometime in April, but the lump sum turnkey contractor faced certain delays and they have revised the date now for synchronization sometime in the third week of June.

management_commitments.claim: The performance guarantee test run for the CCPP is scheduled for the third week of August 2026.
management_commitments.quote: And for the performance guarantee test run to make it available on a full steam basis, it is sometime in the third week of August '26.

management_commitments.claim: Total capex for FY27 is planned at around INR 2,800 crores.
management_commitments.quote: The capex for FY27 is going to be around INR 2,800 crores.

management_commitments.claim: Ammonia expansion, nitric acid, and ammonium nitrate melt projects will come up by next year.
management_commitments.quote: All the three-ammonia expansion, the nitric acid, ammonium nitrate melt, all are going to come up by next year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
